 David Castleberry

Stephenville, TX 76401

July 27, 2026

Public Utility Commission of Texas
PO Box 13326
Austin, TX 78711

RE: Dockets 59029, 59182, 59315, 59336, 59475
Dear Chairman Gleeson & Commissioners,

Earlier this year | submitted several letters to the PUCT encouraging you to deny the
Application to Amend the CCN in Docket 59315. Based on my understanding of this
process, the Commissioners are the only party with power, currently, to do this.

| very much appreciate your willingness to abate the decision in Docket 59029 until the
sister case in Docket 59315 is considered. Now, based on the recent amicus brief and the
recent letter from Senator Sparks and Representative Buckley, | hope you will delay any
final decisions on all the proposed 765-kV projects. Thousands of Texas families and
landowners would be grateful.

The current process and timeline for developing a plan of this magnitude, confirming the
need and selecting a “Best Meets Route” (by making arguments on why your neighbor is a
better target than you are) is unreasonable to all parties other than the Applicants. | hope
hitting the pause button will allow some reasonableness back into the process.
Respectfully,

David Castleberry

                                      David Castleberry __

                                 Stephenville, TX 76401



                                           July 27,2026


Public Utility Commission of Texas
PO Box 13326
Austin, TX 78711

RE:    Dockets 59029,59182,59315,59336,59475

Dear Chairman Gleeson &Commissioners,

Earlier this year I submitted several letters to the PUCT encouraging you to deny the
Application to Amend the CCN in Docket 59315. Based on my understanding of this
process, the Commissioners are the only party with power, currently, to do this.

I very much appreciate your willingness to abate the decision in Docket 59029 until the
sister case in Docket 59315 is considered. Now, based on the recent amicus brief and the
recent letter from Senator Sparks and Representative Buckley, I hope you will delay any
final decisions on all the proposed 765-kV projects. Thousands of Texas families and
landowners would be grateful.

The current process and timeline for developinga plan of this magnitude, confirmingthe
need and selecting a "Best Meets Route" (by making arguments on why your neighbor is a
better target than you are) is unreasonable to all parties other than the Applicants. I hope
hitting the pause button will allow some reasonableness back into the process.

Respectfully,




David Castleberry


CC:    The Honorable Greg Abbott, Governor
